H2200.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02199»; to make an outcry:--cry.

H2201.def: and (feminine) zoaqah {zeh-aw-kaw'}; from «02199»; a shriek or outcry:--cry(-ing).

H2202.et: from an unused root (meaning to be fragrant)
H2202.def: from an unused root (meaning to be fragrant); Ziphron, a place in Palestine:--Ziphron.

H2203.et: from an unused root (meaning to liquify)
H2203.def: from an unused root (meaning to liquify); asphalt (from its tendency to soften in the sun):--pitch.

H2204.def: a primitive root; to be old:--aged man, be (wax) old (man).

H2205.def: from «02204»; old:--aged, ancient (man), elder(-est), old (man, men and...women), senator.

H2208.et: properly, passive participle of (02204) (used only in the plural as a noun)
H2208.def: properly, passive participle of «02204» (used only in the plural as a noun); old age:-old age.

H2210.def: a primitive root; to life, i.e. (figuratively) comfort:--raise (up).

H2211.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02210»; to hang, i.e. impale:--set up.

H2212.def: a primitive root; to strain, (figuratively) extract, clarify:--fine, pour down, purge, purify, refine.

H2213.def: from «02237» (in the sense of scattering); a chaplet (as spread around the top), i.e. (specifically) a border moulding:--crown.

H2214.def: from «02114» (in the sense of estrangement) (compare «02219»); disgust:--loathsome.

H2215.def: a primitive root; to flow away:--wax warm.

H2216.def: from «02215» and «0894»; descended of (i.e. from) Babylon, i.e. born there; Zerubbabel, an Israelite:--Zerubbabel.

H2218.et: from an unused root meaning to be exuberant in growth
H2218.def: from an unused root meaning to be exuberant in growth; lined with shrubbery; Zered, a brook East of the Dead Sea:--Zared, Zered.

H2219.def: a primitive root (compare «02114»); to toss about; by implication, to diffuse, winnow:--cast away, compass, disperse, fan, scatter (away), spread, strew, winnow.

H2220.def: or (shortened) zroao {zer-o'-ah}; and (feminine) zrowpah {zer-o-aw'}; or zrowah {zer-o-aw'}; from «02232»; the arm (as stretched out), or (of animals) the foreleg; figuratively, force:--arm, + help, mighty, power, shoulder, strength.

H2221.def: from «02232»; something sown, i.e. a plant:--sowing, thing that is sown.

H2222.et: by reduplication from an unused root meaning to flow
H2222.def: by reduplication from an unused root meaning to flow; a pouring rain:--water.

H2223.def: by reduplication from «02115»; properly, tightly girt, i.e. probably a racer, or some fleet animal (as being slender in the waist):--+ greyhound.

H2224.def: a primitive root; properly, to irradiate (or shoot forth beams), i.e. to rise (as the sun); specifically, to appear (as a symptom of leprosy):--arise, rise (up), as soon as it is up.

H2226.def: the same as «02225»; Zerach, the name of three Israelites, also of an Idumaean and an Ethiopian prince:--Zarah, Zerah.

H2227.def: patronymically from «02226»; a Zarchite or descendant of Zerach:--Zarchite.

H2228.def: from «02225» and «03050»; Jah has risen: Zerachjah, the name of two Israelites:--Zerahiah.

H2229.def: a primitive root; to gush (as water):--carry away as with a flood, pour out.

H2230.def: from «02229»; a gush of water:--flood, overflowing, shower, storm, tempest.

H2231.def: feminine of «02230»; a gushing of fluid (semen):--issue.

H2232.def: a primitive root; to sow; figuratively, to disseminate, plant, fructify:--bear, conceive seed, set with sow(-er), yield.

H2233.def: from «02232»; seed; figuratively, fruit, plant, sowing-time, posterity:--X carnally, child, fruitful, seed(-time), sowing- time.

H2235.def: or zeraSon {zay-raw-ohn'}; from «02232»; something sown (only in the plural), i.e. a vegetable (as food):--pulse.

H2236.def: a primitive root; to sprinkle (fluid or solid particles):--be here and there, scatter, sprinkle, strew.

H2237.def: a primitive root (compare «02114»); perhaps to diffuse, i.e. (specifically) to sneeze:--sneeze.

H2238.def: of Persian origin; Zeresh, Haman's wife:--Zeresh.

H2239.def: from «02219»; the spread of the fingers, i.e. a span:--span.

H2240.def: of uncertain derivation; Zattu, an Israelite:--Zattu.

H2241.def: apparently a variation for «02133»; Zetham, an &Š Israelite:--Zetham.

H2242.def: of Persian origin; Zethar, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Zethar.

H2243.def: by contraction from «02245»; properly, a cherisher, i.e. the bosom:--bosom.

H2244.def: a primitive root (compare «02245»); to secrete:--X held, hide (self), do secretly.

H2245.def: a primitive root (compare «02244», «02247»); properly, to hide (as in the bosom), i.e. to cherish (with affection):--love.

H2246.def: from «02245»; cherished; Chobab, father-in-law of Moses:--Hobab.

H2249.def: from «02266»; united; Chabor, a river of Assyria:--Habor.

H2250.def: or chabburah {khab-boo-raw'}; or chaburah {khab-oo-raw'}; from «02266»; properly, bound (with stripes), i.e. a weal (or black-and-blue mark itself):--blueness, bruise, hurt, stripe, wound.

H2251.def: a primitive root; to knock out or off:--beat (off, out), thresh.

H2252.def: or Chabayah {khab-aw-yaw'}; from «02247» and «03050»; Jah has hidden; Chabajah, an Israelite:--Habaiah.

H2254.def: a primitive root; to wind tightly (as a rope), i.e. to bind; specifically, by a pledge; figuratively, to pervert, destroy; also to writhe in pain (especially of parturition):--X at all, band, bring forth, (deal) corrupt(-ly), destroy, offend, lay &Š to (take a) pledge, spoil, travail, × very, withhold.

H2256.def: or chebel {khay'-bel}; from «02254»; a rope (as twisted), especially a measuring line; by implication, a district or inheritance (as measured); or a noose (as of cords); figuratively, a company (as if tied together); also a throe (especially of parturition); also ruin:--band, coast, company, cord, country, destruction, line, lot, pain, pang, portion, region, rope, snare, sorrow, tackling.

H2258.def: or (feminine) chabolah {khab-o-law'}; from «02254»; a pawn (as security for debt):--pledge.

H2259.et: act. participle from (02254) (in the sense of handling ropes)
H2259.def: active participle from «02254» (in the sense of handling ropes); a sailor:--pilot, shipmaster.

H2260.et: from (02254) (in the sense of furnished with ropes)
H2260.def: from «02254» (in the sense of furnished with ropes); a mast:--mast.

H2262.def: of uncertain derivation; Chabatstsanjah, a Rechabite:--Habazaniah.

H2263.def: a primitive root; to clasp (the hands or in embrace):--embrace, fold.

H2264.def: from «02263»; a clasping of the hands (in idleness):--fold.

H2265.def: by reduplication from «02263»; embrace; Chabakkuk, the prophet:--Habakkuk.

H2266.def: a primitive root; to join (literally or figuratively); specifically (by means of spells) to fascinate:--charm(- er), be compact, couple (together), have fellowship with, heap up, join (self, together), league.

H2267.def: from «02266»; a society; also a spell:--+ charmer(- ing), company, enchantment, × wide.

H2268.def: the same as «02267»; community; Cheber, the name of a Kenite and of three Israelites:--Heber.

H2269.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02266»; an associate:--companion, fellow.

H2270.def: from «02266»; an associate:--companion, fellow, knit together.

H2272.def: by reduplication from «02266»; a streak (like a line), as on the tiger:--spot.

H2275.def: from «02267»; seat of association; Chebron, a place in Palestine, also the name of two Israelites:--Hebron.

H2276.def: or Chebroniy {kheb-ro-nee'}; patronymically from «02275»; Chebronite (collectively), an inhabitant of Chebron:--Hebronites.

H2277.def: patronymically from «02268»; a Chebrite (collectively) or descendants of Cheber:--Heberites.

H2279.def: feminine active participle of «02266»; a joint:--which coupleth, coupling.

H2280.def: a primitive root; to wrap firmly (especially a turban, compress, or saddle); figuratively, to stop, to rule:--bind (up), gird about, govern, healer, put, saddle, wrap about.

H2281.et: from an unused root probably meaning to cook [compare (04227)]
H2281.def: from an unused root probably meaning to cook (compare «04227»); something fried, probably a griddle-cake:--pan.

H2282.def: or chag {khawg}; from «02287»; a festival, or a victim therefor:--(solemn) feast (day), sacrifice, solemnity.

H2283.et: from an unused root meaning to revolve [compare (02287)]
H2283.def: from an unused root meaning to revolve (compare «02287»); properly, vertigo, i.e. (figuratively) fear:--terror.

H2285.def: the same as «02284»; locust; Chagab, one of the Nethinim:--Hagab.

H2286.def: or Chagabah {khag-aw-baw'}; feminine of «02285»; locust; Chagaba or Chagabah, one of the Nethinim:--Hagaba, Hagabah.

H2287.def: a primitive root (compare «02283», «02328»); properly, to move in a circle, i.e. (specifically) to march in a sacred procession, to observe a festival; by implication, to be giddy:--celebrate, dance, (keep, hold) a (solemn) feast (holiday), reel to and fro.

H2288.et: from an unused root meaning to take refuge
H2288.def: from an unused root meaning to take refuge; a rift in rocks:--cleft.

H2290.def: or chagor {khag-ore'}; and (feminine) chagowrah {khag-o-raw'}; or chagorah {khag-o-raw'}; from «02296»; a belt (for the waist):--apron, armour, gird(-le).

H2291.def: from «02287»; festive, Chaggi, an Israelite; also (patronymically) a Chaggite, or descendant of the same:--Haggi, Haggites.

H2292.def: from «02282»; festive; Chaggai, a Heb. prophet:--Haggai.

H2293.def: from «02282» and «03050»; festival of Jah; Chaggijah, an Israelite:--Haggiah.

H2294.def: feminine of «02291»; festive; Chaggith, a wife of David:--Haggith.

H2295.def: of uncertain derivation; probably a partridge; Choglah, an Israelitess:--Hoglah. See also «01031».

H2296.def: a primitive root; to gird on (as a belt, armor, etc.):--be able to put on, be afraid, appointed, gird, restrain, × on every side.

H2298.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02297»; as card. one; as article single; as an ordinal, first; adverbially, at once:--a, first, one, together.
